program: CXCL8 (IL-8) — human chemokine with no mouse ortholog
in_vitro_finding: Strongly induced in human cells (epithelium, monocytes) by inflammatory stimuli.
in_vivo_finding: Mouse has no CXCL8 gene; neutrophil chemotaxis is carried by Cxcl1/Cxcl2 (KC/MIP-2). There is nothing to compare to.
patient_finding: Elevated in inflamed patient tissue/serum across many diseases (persists human in vitro → patient).
